integrity.proof_type: self-contained mathematical argument using standard elliptic-curve and projective-bundle facts

scientific_limitations: The theorem is over the complex numbers and restricted to decomposable degree-zero elliptic ruled surfaces. It makes no classification of all Galois maps or of indecomposable projective bundles. Its deck groups belong to the explicitly constructed morphisms; no independent validation has occurred.
title: Polarized versus Galois int-amplified self-covers of elliptic ruled surfaces
